Subject: Usage dip ahead of renewal — evidence & forecast guidance

Hi team / Samira,

Quick note: finance flagged a 28% drop in token activity for LumenWare over the last 6 weeks versus the prior quarter. Their renewal (annual, renew date 2028-01-05) is on next quarter's spreadsheet and we need a fast posture on commit probability and tranche treatment.

What I'm attaching: a short export (usage_report_lumenware_2027-09.csv) and a link to the live dashboard above. The key asks:
- Samira: can you confirm why the usage dropped (feature toggle, contract usage caps, internal pause)? Any short note or an internal incident we should be aware of?
- Internal: please update the HubSpot deal stage and probability by EOD Fri (HubSpot link included). If we have no firm plan to recover usage we should lower probability and reflect in the finance forecast.

If this is a temporary integration delay, CS should outline a mitigation plan (timeline + top-5 affected seats). If this is intentional (product deprioritization), we need an immediate renewal flag and potential discount request routing.

Attachments: usage_report_lumenware_2027-09.csv (CSV)
Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/lumenware/usage?range=6w

Thanks — priorities: evidence (Samira), outreach owner (Ben), CRM update (Aditya).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@lumenware.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumenware.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage dip ahead of renewal — evidence & forecast guidance

Thanks Kimberly — quick response from our side.

Short version: we intentionally dialed back a couple of non-core integrations over the summer while our engineering team focused on a product replatform. That reduced event emission from two internal pipelines (approx -22% of tokens). Additionally one enterprise customer (BrightLayer) paused a non-critical sync for six weeks during their internal budget cycle (~-6%). Neither is a platform outage; both are expected to recover but timing is uncertain.

I've attached a short breakdown (lumenware-usage-breakdown.pdf) showing which integrations and which accounts drove the decline. Procurement is CC'd — if you need a written confirmation for renewal discussions I can route a statement.

On the renewal: our controller is evaluating the timing. We prefer not to commit to early upsell until the platform replatform stabilizes. Happy to join a sync to calibrate probability and discuss short-term concessions if needed.

—Samira
Director, Cloud Integrations
LumenWare
